_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score remains coiled inside Disbelief with mixed factors; base-rate favors HOLD until VIX/gold ease or reserves confirm distribution.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly HOLD/Disbelief; narrative supplies flow context but no opposing forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d rises and retail_noise_sentiment stays elevated while gold/VIX remain firm
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX drops sharply and gold_strength declines with sustained risk-on breadth
